dialogues.speaker: Arcantel
dialogues.text: Miss, have you ever heard of the "Ultra-Revivalist School"?

dialogues.speaker: Oia
dialogues.text: No, I'm afraid to say I'm a bit behind the times when it comes to fashion.

dialogues.speaker: Arcantel
dialogues.text: Nonononono, that's not your fault! You know why? Because I just created it!

dialogues.speaker: Oia
dialogues.text: Ohhh, so what does it mean?

dialogues.speaker: Arcantel
dialogues.text: It's a school of art that I am about to guide, pioneer, and carry up to lofty heights!

dialogues.speaker: Arcantel
dialogues.text: As for what the style will be... Hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Arcantel
dialogues.text: That depends on what I end up drawing next!

dialogues.speaker: Oia
dialogues.text: Of course! Isn't that how all popular art goes?

dialogues.speaker: Oia
dialogues.text: They start with a concept, then give it a name, and finally, they try and give it as much exposure as they can so that it baffles as many people as possible, and... Tada! You've created the latest fad.
